title: Add per-golfer gross totals, manual golfer count (1–64), and blank tournament title by default

requirements.text: In the score entry step, display a per-golfer gross total (sum of entered hole scores) after that golfer’s scores are entered.

quotes: add a gross score total after each golfer's scores are entered.

acceptanceCriteria: When a golfer has all hole scores filled with valid numbers, a gross total is shown within that golfer’s score entry card.
The gross total updates immediately when any hole score for that golfer changes.
If one or more hole scores are missing/blank, do not show an incorrect total (either hide the total or show a clear placeholder such as "Gross Total: —").

requirements.text: Replace the "Number of Golfers" dropdown in the event setup form with a manual numeric input constrained to an integer between 1 and 64 inclusive.

quotes: change the number of golfers from a dropdown to a manual entry number between 1  and 64.

acceptanceCriteria: The event setup form uses a numeric input for golfer count (not a dropdown/select).
The input prevents or blocks submission with values outside 1–64 (including empty, 0, negatives, or >64).
On successful submission, the score entry step initializes exactly the specified number of golfer entry cards.

requirements.text: Default the Tournament Title field to be blank and do not auto-fill a fallback title when the user leaves it empty.
acceptanceCriteria: On initial load of the event setup form, the Tournament Title input value is an empty string (no prefilled title).
Submitting the setup form with an empty Tournament Title preserves it as empty (no automatic replacement with a default title).
The app header continues to display a reasonable fallback label when the title is empty (e.g., the existing behavior showing a default app name), but the stored event title remains blank.

requirements.text: When the event title is blank, ensure the leaderboard and PDF export do not render an empty title line (omit the title heading/print title or substitute a non-title-safe fallback only for document metadata).
acceptanceCriteria: If the event title is blank, the leaderboard title section does not show an empty large heading.
PDF export still works when the event title is blank (no empty/awkward header line in the printed output).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn UI components are read-only).
Do not edit immutable hook/bootstrap files listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts).
Backend remains single-actor in backend/main.mo; no backend changes are required for these UI-only updates.
nonGoals: Do not change Callaway calculation logic or leaderboard ranking/tie-break rules.
Do not add new authentication methods or external integrations.
Do not introduce real-time/multiplayer scoring or persistence beyond existing behavior.
